question: The amount of certain sum in 3 years at simple interest at x% p.a is Rs. 5,472 and the amount of the same sum is 7(1)/(2) years at the same rate, at simple interest is Rs. 6,930. the value of x is:
solution:
Given:

A sum in 3 years at simple interest at x% p.a is Rs. 5,472.

The same sum in 7(1)/(2) i.e., 7.5 years at x% p.a. at simple interest is Rs. 6,930.

Concept used:

Simple Interest, SI = (P × R × T)/100

Amount = P + SI

Where, P = Principal amount, R = Rate of interest per year, 

T = Time in years

Calculation:

Let the sum be Rs. p.

According to the question,

p + (p × x × 3)/100 = 5472 ....(1)

According to the question,

p + (p × x × 7.5)/100 = 6930 ....(2)

Subtracting equation (1) from equation (2),

p + (p × x × 7.5)/100 - p - (p × x × 3)/100 = 6930 - 5472

⇒ 7.5xp/100 - 3xp/100 = 1458

⇒ 4.5xp/100 = 1458

⇒ xp = 145800/4.5

⇒ xp = 32400 ....(3)

Putting xp = 32400 in (2),

p + (p × x × 7.5)/100 = 6930

⇒ p + (32400 × 7.5)/100 = 6930

⇒ p = 6930 - (32400 × 7.5)/100

⇒ p = 6930 - 2430

⇒ p = 4500 ....(4)

Putting p = 4500 in (3),

x × 4500 = 32400

⇒ x = 32400/4500

⇒ x = 7.2

∴ The value of x is 7.2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

When 'rate of interest' is uniform and time varies then-

R = large{((A₁ - A₂)/(A₂× T₁ - A₁× T₂))× 100}

Where, A₁ = First amount, A₂ = Second amount

T₁ = first time, T₂ = Second time, R = Rate of interest

∴ According to the question -

R = [(5472 - 6930)/(6930 × 3 - 5472 × 7.5)] × 100

R = [(-1458)/(20790 - 41040)] × 100

R = (1458/20250) × 100

R = 7.2%

∴ **Required rate of interest is 7.2% **
